result:
Created `tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 3 (`junit.framework.TestCase`) test class covering `CSVFormat`:

- All predefined formats (`DEFAULT`, `EXCEL`, `RFC4180`, `TDF`, `MYSQL`, `INFORMIX_UNLOAD`, `INFORMIX_UNLOAD_CSV`) against their documented settings
- `newFormat` defaults and its line-break rejection
- `valueOf` for valid/invalid names
- Every `withXxx`/`getXxx`/`isXxxSet` pair (delimiter, escape, comment marker, quote, quote mode, record separator, null string, ignore-empty-lines, ignore-header-case, ignore-surrounding-spaces, allow-missing-column-names, skip-header-record, trailing-delimiter, trim), including boundary cases (line-break rejection, null disabling, invalid record separator strings)
- `withHeader` overloads (`String...`, enum `Class`, `ResultSetMetaData` via a minimal stub, and the no-arg/null forms) plus defensive-copy behavior for `getHeader`/`getHeaderComments`
- Immutability, `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString` contracts
- `format`, `print`/`println`/`printRecord`/`print(value, out, newRecord)`, `print(File,Charset)`, `print(Path,Charset)`, and `parse(Reader)`

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
